title: Generic Retry
description:
Implement a `retry<T>` function that calls an async function up to `maxAttempts` times, returning the first successful result. If all attempts fail, throw the last error.

**Signature:**
```ts
async function retry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, maxAttempts: number): Promise<T>
```
ai_context: Tests async/await, generics, and error handling. The student likely knows try/catch but may not think to track the last error or use a for loop.
